updates.title: v0.3.3: SD card maps and Files over Wi-Fi
updates.text: On radios with a card slot (Heltec V4-R8, T-Deck Plus, ThinkNode M9) the map keeps its tiles on the SD card and shows ready-made map packs from Meshtastic or MeshCore. Settings > Storage turns on Files over Wi-Fi: manage the card from a browser with a code shown on the radio. Tap to wake on the Heltec V4 kits.

updates.title: v0.3.2: ThinkNode M9 arrow keys
updates.text: On the ThinkNode M9 the arrow keys now move freely, up, down, left and right, to the control that way on screen, including the map's Fit, minus and plus buttons, the tab bar and the Settings gear.

updates.title: v0.3.1: All of Meshtastic 2.8, any country
updates.text: Every Meshtastic 2.8 preset and region, including the ham 70 cm and 1.25 m bands in licensed mode. Pick your country for a legal region, or a local mesh for its settings in one tap. Full MQTT set-up with uplink, map report and more, plus every Meshtastic setting on one page. Steadier touch, and a tap wakes the Heltec V4 screens.

updates.title: v0.3.0: T-Deck Plus and ThinkNode M9
updates.text: Hoptics MT now runs on the LilyGO T-Deck Plus and the Elecrow ThinkNode M9 (beta), with a landscape layout and full keyboard and trackball control. The M9's location key opens a new Location card. Plugged-in radios stay awake with the screen off.

updates.title: v0.2.4: Reach check
updates.text: See how far your messages get: gateways that upload them to MQTT are counted by hops, on the radio and in a new Reach logger on the web page. MQTT can now be set up on the radio itself. Also fixes the V4-R8 SD card slot and some overlapping text.

updates.title: Hoptics for MeshCore
updates.text: A big-screen version for the CrowPanel 10.1 is being built. More to share soon.
